Name: Seraiah, Son of Azriel
Summary: Seraiah, son of Azriel, was one of the officers Jehoiakim sent to seize Jeremiah and Baruch after the scroll was burned, but the Lord hid them. He is a different man from Seraiah son of Neriah, Seraiah the chief priest, and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth.
KeyStory: The king commanded Seraiah son of Azriel to take Jeremiah and Baruch, but the Lord hid them.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Baruch
LifeLesson: A shared name does not mean a shared story — four Seraiahs walk through Jeremiah, and each must be told apart.
